bookings: Six-character synthetic reservation reference (PNR locator), independent of the internal booking key.
Channel used to place the reservation: WEB, MOBILE, AGENCY or CONTACT_CENTER.
Reservation status in the final snapshot; CONFIRMED means the itinerary was reserved.
ISO 4217 currency of the booking amounts.
Total base fare in whole KRW, summed over tickets in this booking.
Total taxes and fees in whole KRW, summed over tickets.
Total fare plus taxes in whole KRW.
Payment state at the reservation snapshot. PAID indicates settled payment.
passengers: Fictional given name; part of the display name.
Fictional family name; part of the display name.
Two-letter service language code, not necessarily the passenger nationality.
Synthetic frequent-flyer tier; NULL means no tier recorded.
tickets: Synthetic 13-digit electronic document number using a dummy prefix; not valid for travel.
Ticket document snapshot status; ISSUED means the ticket exists, not that every coupon was flown.
Distribution channel through which this document was issued.
ISO 4217 currency for the ticket fare.
Ticket base fare in whole KRW, summed across its segments.
Ticket tax and fee total in whole KRW.
Ticket base fare plus taxes in whole KRW.
Commercial fare product: ECONOMY_SAVER, ECONOMY_FLEX or BUSINESS.
passenger_legs: One-based coupon position in chronological order within the ticket itinerary.
Reservation booking class code for the segment, using local synthetic Y, M or J values.
Cabin associated with the fare product: ECONOMY or BUSINESS.
Local synthetic fare basis code for the segment.
Assigned seat designator. NULL means no seat assignment in the observed departure records.
Sequence of successful check-in within the dated flight; NULL if no completed check-in exists.
Departure-system snapshot derived from observed processing: BOOKED, CHECKED_IN or BOARDED.
Number of included checked bags; additional paid bags can exceed the allowance.
Allocated segment base fare in whole KRW.
Allocated segment taxes and fees in whole KRW.
passenger_actions: Three-letter airport code where the processing action occurred.
WEB, MOBILE, KIOSK, COUNTER or GATE; reflects the system channel.
Synthetic terminal designation; NULL for remote web/mobile check-in.
Local synthetic processing device or application identifier.
Processing result in the source system: OK or REJECTED.
Local synthetic reason code for a rejected boarding scan; NULL for successful actions.
bag_legs: Ten-digit synthetic bag-tag license plate using dummy carrier prefix 0999; not an issued tag.
Measured checked-bag mass in kilograms, synthetic.
Physical baggage category: STANDARD, OVERSIZE or SPECIAL.
Three-letter airport code of the associated operating leg's origin.
Three-letter airport code of the associated operating leg's destination.
Last observed tracking state: ACCEPTED or LOADED. No arrival or delivery is inferred.
bag_scans: Airport where tracking observation was recorded.
Local tracking location: BAG_DROP or AIRCRAFT_LOADING.
Synthetic scanner identifier local to the station and location.
Tracking capture method: BARCODE or RFID.
Synthetic cart/container reference for a loading observation; NULL if not recorded.
Local baggage reconciliation or handling system identifier.
checkpoints: Synthetic terminal designation at the airport represented by zone.
Passenger checkpoint category used in this benchmark.
Number of modeled screening lanes at this checkpoint.
Checkpoint availability in the master-data snapshot.
security_visits: Local service queue category: STANDARD or PRIORITY.
Synthetic lane number; NULL when screening has not started.
Last observed visit state: QUEUED, IN_SCREENING or COMPLETED; does not assert a security clearance decision.
security_events: Airport code of the visit checkpoint.
Synthetic observation device reference, not a real airport installation.
Local observation capture method: SENSOR or SYSTEM_RECORD.
Local record quality indicator: VALIDATED or UNREVIEWED.
airlines: Synthetic two-character carrier prefix used by the fixture flight numbers; not an assertion of real IATA assignment.
Synthetic carrier registration country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.
Commercial service category used in the synthetic register.
aircraft: Fictional internal registration reference; not a real civil-aircraft registration.
Manufacturer associated with the existing aircraft model.
Aircraft family type designation used in this model.
Modeled total installed seat capacity; passenger records cover a sample, not the full manifest.
employees: Organizational unit responsible for the employee's role.
Synthetic qualification snapshot, not an actual license or regulatory certification.
flight_dispatch: Synthetic planned alternate airport code, not a dispatch recommendation.
Illustrative planned block fuel mass in kilograms; not an operational fuel calculation.
Illustrative minimum fuel mass, not a certified dispatch value.
Assignment snapshot status; ASSIGNED does not assert a signed dispatch release.
